items.description: At least five children were reportedly killed in the strike, which appears to have targeted a Hamas commander.

items.title: Are US and Iran close to peace or sliding back to war?
items.description: Neither side seems interested in a return to all-out conflict, despite the latest exchange of strikes.

items.title: Iran says it targeted American base after fresh US strikes
items.description: The hostilities come during a fragile ceasefire between the US and Iran, and protracted negotiations to end the three-month war.

items.title: Israel hits Lebanese capital in 'targeted strike'
items.description: Beirut had until now largely been spared even as both Israel and Hezbollah accused each other of breaking last month's ceasefire.

items.title: Villas, cars and cash: Italy seizes dead Mafia mobster's millions
items.description: Police say the operation targeted the network of notorious late Sicilian mafia boss Matteo Messina Denaro.

items.title: Portugal breaks hottest May day record as Europe swelters in heatwave
items.description: French students are taking their exams in baking schools, while red alerts are issued in Italy.

items.title: US justice department launches criminal investigation into Trump accuser E Jean Carroll
items.description: The case centres on whether the former columnist lied about the funding she received for her civil lawsuit against the US president.

items.title: Man arrested after three injured in stabbing at Swiss train station
items.description: A 31-year-old Swiss man has been arrested, police say, as images from the scene show parts of the station cordoned off.

items.title: Questions over safety as 16 pupils die in another Kenya school fire
items.description: Several parents were still waiting for news of their children roughly 12 hours after the fire.

items.title: Jill Biden says she thought husband was having a stroke during 2024 debate

items.title: Australia charges woman who returned from Syria with joining Islamic State
items.description: Several groups of women and children who spent years in a Syrian camp have returned in recent months.

items.title: EU fines Temu €200m for allowing sale of illegal products
